title: carex vulpina var. compacta
intro: Carex vulpina var. compacta, commonly known as Fox Sedge, is a compact, clump-forming perennial grass native to North America, belonging to the family Cyperaceae. This plant has been traditionally used to treat various health issues, with its health benefits attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Fox Sedge include relieving respiratory issues such as bronchitis and coughs, as well as reducing inflammation and promoting wound healing. The bioactive constituents of Carex vulpina var. compacta include phenolic acids, flavonoids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
